A '''stim trader''' worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] began charging high prices for medicine and [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] to veteran [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], prompting an individual to visit the trader and convince him to lower his prices.<ref name="Meds for Vets" />
